name: comp-166

frames.best_why: Plus is chosen with its lighter row and Popular badge, and no cursor sits over the list.

tagline: Four stacked plans; the picked row lifts out of the column.
summary: A vertical radio list of four subscription plans with their prices, joined into one bordered column. The selected plan takes a lighter background, and the Plus row carries a Popular badge.
appearance: Four rows stack flush inside a single thin grey outline on black, each row holding a radio circle, a plan name on the left and a small grey price on the right. Plus shows a white Popular pill beside its name, and its row has a lighter grey fill.
behaviour: Clicking a row fills its radio dot and raises the row's background and border. The recording starts with Plus chosen and switches to Hobby, then back to Plus.
demo_content: Choose plan heading; Hobby $9/mo, Plus $29/mo, Team $49/mo, Enterprise Custom
search_phrases: choose a subscription plan from a list
popular plan badge in a list
use_when: At signup or upgrade, when one of a few priced tiers must be chosen in a narrow space.
avoid_when: Rows show only a name and price, so a plan needing a feature list is a poor fit for this shape.
customise: Plans come from an items array in the file; edit names, prices, values and which row takes the badge there. Row padding, radius and the accent fill are classes in the same file.
weight_why: Four static rows with native radios; the state swap has no animation.

a11y.note: Real radios with visible labels, and each price is linked to its radio by aria-describedby; arrow keys move the choice and nothing animates.

issues: The Popular badge crowds the $29/mo price on the Plus row, with almost no gap.
Prices are tiny grey text and read weakly against black.
polish_why: Clean joined rows and clear selection, spoiled by the badge colliding with the price.
